items.text: Jalen Hurts (blood clots) is on IR; Tanner McKee starts. The schedule data still lists Hurts, so the model uses McKee.

Saturday report for Monday: Philadelphia ruled out WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), OLB Nolan Smith (concussion) and DB Michael Carter (abdomen); RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring), EDGEs Jonathan Greenard and Jalyx Hunt, G Landon Dickerson, CB Jakorian Bennett and TEs Grant Calcaterra and Eli Stowers are questionable.

Saturday report for Monday: Dallas ruled out OT Drew Shelton (hamstring), WR/KR KaVontae Turpin (ribs) and LB Dee Winters (calf); OLB Marist Liufau and S P.J. Locke are questionable. Dak Prescott starts.
